name: get_claim_document_metadata
description: Return metadata (type, content type, size, presence) for the documents submitted with the active investigation job. Does not return document content.

job_id.description: UUID of the active investigation job.

claim_id.description: Claim identifier; must match the job. Pattern ^[A-Z0-9][A-Z0-9-]{3,63}$.

correlation_id.description: Correlation ID of the job. Pattern ^[A-Za-z0-9-]{8,64}$.

name: get_policy_guidance
description: Retrieve synthetic investigation guidance chunks relevant to the query for the claim type. Returns an empty list when nothing relevant is indexed.

job_id.description: UUID of the active investigation job.

claim_id.description: Claim identifier; must match the job.

name: search_similar_claims
description: Retrieve synthetic historical claim examples similar to the query for the claim type. Returns an empty list when nothing relevant is indexed.

job_id.description: UUID of the active investigation job.

claim_id.description: Claim identifier; must match the job.

name: persist_investigation_findings
description: Validate and store the advisory investigation report for the active job, then record COMPLETED or REVIEW_REQUIRED. The status is derived from the validated report.

job_id.description: UUID of the active investigation job.

claim_id.description: Claim identifier; must match the job.

report_markdown.description: Human-readable Markdown rendering of the same result.

name: update_job_status
description: Record PROCESSING (from QUEUED) or FAILED (from QUEUED or PROCESSING) for the job. Cannot set COMPLETED or REVIEW_REQUIRED.

claim_id.description: Claim identifier; must match the job.

failure_category.description: Required when status is FAILED: RUNTIME_ERROR, TIMEOUT, TOOL_ERROR, DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE, INTERNAL.

processing_deadline.description: ISO-8601 UTC deadline; used when status is PROCESSING.
